scope: 12 reference concepts; not the entire corpus
reviewer: assistant visual inspection of actual desktop/narrow screenshots and source structure

deduplication.claim: No obvious complete duplicate among these twelve under common copy/tokens; this is an editorial review, not proof of uniqueness across 146 screens or 820 style keys.

closeGroups.reason: Central focal structure; scale, supporting copy/actions and the lower ribbon distinguish treatment. Count as a related group, not three unrelated composition principles.
Same dense-grid family; two large upper masses versus a central cell and surrounding cells.
Related split balance; local stats in the text column versus a separate full-width evidence band.

concepts.desktop: Central headline/action structure survives normalized tokens and copy.
concepts.narrow: Authored title fits, but the navigation collides. Longer normalized text and actions exceed the fixed first screen.
concepts.decision: Retain; define mobile header and text length limits.

concepts.desktop: Clear text/media balance; supporting stats remain within the text column.
concepts.narrow: Two columns and fixed gaps squeeze text. Media overlays the text/actions; narrow mode is not usable adaptation.
concepts.decision: Retain; mobile requires reordered single-column structure.

concepts.desktop: Media band above monumental typography remains distinct from a centred poster.
concepts.narrow: Fixed monumental text size overflows the available width; the frame clips content.
concepts.decision: Retain as desktop poster; responsive type scale is required for mobile.

concepts.desktop: Small central message and single action; circle/dots visibly participate in the composition.
concepts.narrow: Core message remains readable, but centered brand/navigation/action overlap in the header. No bounds flag does not mean no overlap.
concepts.decision: Retain as quiet centre; reduce competition between media and message by task context.

concepts.desktop: Split thesis/media and separate stats band. The fourth stat repeats the first because the source has three data items.
concepts.narrow: Media compresses and four stats crowd together; long copy overflows.
concepts.decision: Retain; use truthful distinct stats or fewer items, and a mobile evidence layout.

concepts.desktop: Central message plus a lower logo ribbon differentiates the evidence layer. Abstract icons are not customer endorsements.
concepts.narrow: Header, central text and lower ribbon exceed or clip within narrow areas.
concepts.decision: Keep within the focal family; justify ribbon by content, not as automatic proof of trust.

concepts.desktop: Editorial columns and low middle title remain distinct with common copy.
concepts.narrow: Three columns squeeze copy; central title/media conflict and long text pushes beyond the frame.
concepts.decision: Retain; mobile must specify editorial reading order before stacking.

concepts.desktop: Title above a wide browser-like stage remains a clear frame composition.
concepts.narrow: Outer message mostly remains legible with authored copy; the inner specimen clips and navigation overlaps.
concepts.decision: Retain; distinguish product illustration from functional interface and adapt the specimen separately.

concepts.desktop: Central input/action differs from a CTA-only hero. Side geometric bands frame the task.
concepts.narrow: Side bands consume most width and conflict with content. The input has a placeholder but no explicit label/ARIA name.
concepts.decision: Retain as input-led concept; label the field and collapse/reduce decorative rails in a mobile adaptation.

concepts.desktop: Two large upper masses and four lower slots show a clear modular hierarchy.
concepts.narrow: Four-column structure and fixed row spans squeeze text and controls; media overlaps and content clips.
concepts.decision: Retain; define mobile priorities and card order rather than shrinking the grid.

concepts.desktop: Central cell and surrounding metrics/media differ from the hierarchical bento.
concepts.narrow: Three-column cross collapses into narrow strips; text/action no longer carry the intended hierarchy.
concepts.decision: Retain; mobile needs another arrangement preserving the central message.

concepts.desktop: Upper-start text and lower-end image establish a diagonal pause with ample empty space.
concepts.narrow: The absolute image covers part of the CTA with authored text and more content with long copy, despite near-zero bounds flags.
concepts.decision: Retain; mobile media should enter content flow or reserve explicit space.

priorities.action: Label desktop-only style previews accurately. Narrow diagnostics are not supported mobile layouts.
Specify responsive reading order, navigation, type scale and decoration behavior before declaring ready-to-use mobile presets.
Supply a persistent accessible label for prompt fields before using them as functional examples.
Use structural/task passports and related groups; do not count token variants as new concepts.
Replace repeated stats and abstract endorsement signals with appropriate real project content.

openChecks: Contrast of all text over procedural media and transparent backgrounds
Semantic/accessibility audit beyond basic DOM and keyboard checks
Visual review of the rest of the corpus
